mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_policy_recommendation_log (session_ref, company_profile, query_text, recommended_policy_ids, ml_scores, interaction_type, policy_id, interacted_at) VALUES ( #{sessionRef}, #{companyProfile}::jsonb, #{queryText}, #{recommendedPolicyIds}::jsonbNULL, #{mlScores}::jsonbNULL, #{interactionType}, #{policyId}, #{interactedAt} )
mapper.select: WITH viewed AS ( SELECT DISTINCT session_ref FROM ai_policy_recommendation_log WHERE interaction_type = 'VIEWED' AND recommended_at >= #{from} AND recommended_at < (#{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') ), clicked AS ( SELECT DISTINCT session_ref FROM ai_policy_recommendation_log WHERE interaction_type = 'CLICKED' AND recommended_at >= #{from} AND recommended_at < (#{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') ), applied AS ( SELECT DISTINCT session_ref FROM ai_policy_recommendation_log WHERE interaction_type = 'APPLIED' AND recommended_at >= #{from} AND recommended_at < (#{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') ), agg AS ( SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM viewed) AS total_viewed, (SELECT count(*) FROM clicked c WHERE c.session_ref IN (SELECT session_ref FROM viewed)) AS total_clicked, (SELECT count(*) FROM applied a WHERE a.session_ref IN (SELECT session_ref FROM viewed)) AS total_applied ) SELECT #{period} AS period, CASE WHEN total_viewed = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE round(total_clicked::numeric / total_viewed, 4) END AS ctr, CASE WHEN total_viewed = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE round(total_applied::numeric / total_viewed, 4) END AS conversionRate, 0.0 AS coverage, total_viewed AS totalViewed, total_clicked AS totalClicked, total_applied AS totalApplied FROM agg

SELECT count(DISTINCT pid) FROM ai_policy_recommendation_log, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(recommended_policy_ids) AS pid WHERE interaction_type = 'VIEWED' AND recommended_policy_ids IS NOT NULL AND recommended_at >= #{from} AND recommended_at < (#{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
SELECT count(*) FROM policy_program WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND (application_end IS NULL OR application_end >= now())
SELECT id FROM policy_program WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND (application_end IS NULL OR application_end >= now()) ORDER BY application_end ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
